name: keysrs
description: Agent surface for Keysrs, the local Mac API-key vault: the keysrs skill and the `keys mcp` server. Needs Keysrs.app on macOS (brew install --cask gshost1/keysrs/keysrs, or keysrs.com).
long_description: Keysrs keeps provider API keys in the macOS Keychain behind Touch ID and hands agents scoped, expiring gateway grants instead of keys. This bundle only starts the `keys mcp` server of the installed app; it contains no app, no key and no setting. It needs Keysrs.app in /Applications on macOS (brew install --cask gshost1/keysrs/keysrs, or keysrs.com).
